value.rationale: The all-positive-start admissible cone is an intrinsic numerical reliability invariant for a recently optimized stiff time integrator. Its full classification explains why the scheme at κ=1/2 tolerates every positive starting error over the unique largest step range, while at κ>1/2 a nonempty region admits only an infinitely fragile eigenmode startup. Prior fixed-start thresholds cannot answer this robustness question; the exact sharp boundaries are useful for choosing startup schemes and diagnosing loss of positivity.
